comments:
Independent composition on Madhyamaka articulated around the presentation of the Two Truths according to a structure common to other authors such as rGya dmar ba, Gro lung pa, etc. The author support the Svātantrika orientation and criticizes followers of Candrakīrti. Its composition predates the
commentary on the Madhyamakāloka (ID:4484), which mentions its title.

This text could corresponds to either the short or large "bsdus pa" listed A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 523, No. 11321: [phya pa chos seng gi...] dbu ma'i bsdus pa che chung gnyis). The other work is not extant (ID:6568).
